name: store listing: rejects Jameson Cold Brew as an additive-flavor product

provenance.notes: Jameson says Cold Brew combines Jameson Irish Whiskey with Arabica coffee, and Pernod Ricard lists it at 30% ABV. The Irish Whiskey technical file requires at least 40% ABV. It is therefore an additive-flavor spirit outside the classifier's whisky scope. The existing Peated Bottle does not override that scope. 2026-10-25: the case now expects ignored under the owner scope ruling. evidence/ci.json gained the producer page result (Arabica coffee with Jameson Irish Whiskey) and a retailer listing at 30% ABV, the sources M02 cites; before this, the controlled pack supplied no evidence that flavor was added.

expected.summary: Producer evidence shows Jameson Cold Brew adds coffee flavor to whiskey, so it is outside the whisky catalog. Ignore it.
